adopt: Hatch a companion, teach it something, and watch what it becomes.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
A companion that never changes is a toy, and one whose growth you cannot see or edit is a black box. Most "AI pet" products are a chat window with a sprite pasted on top -- nothing you taught it persists, and nothing about how it grew is checkable.

Install
pip install awsprite

Commands
  awsprite

Quick start
  pip install awsprite
  
  awsprite --url https://sprite.example status
  awsprite --url https://sprite.example talk "good morning!"
  awsprite --url https://sprite.example teach notes.md
  awsprite --url https://sprite.example list

Docs
https://aitherium.github.io/awsprite/
synopsis: Hatch a companion that grows only from what you teach it, then take it home.
